Scary moment at UFC Vegas 121. Raoni Barcelos went limp during a takedown exchange with Raul Rosas Jr. in the fifth round of their main event Saturday night in Las Vegas. The fight was stopped immediately, and Barcelos was placed on a stretcher and taken to the hospital. Rosas Jr. was awarded the fifth-round KO. UFC International Reporter Evelyn Rodrigues said Barcelos regained consciousness inside the ambulance and has been transported to the hospital. Barcelos’ coach provided a video update that he was doing fine and will undergo a CT scan.
